root_cause: Native flutter_webrtc returns RTCStats.timestamp_us for Android, iOS, and macOS. Flutter screen receiver diagnostics consumed that value as milliseconds, while the existing sender path already converted microseconds to milliseconds. This inflated receiver intervals by 1000x, suppressing calculated decoded FPS, bitrate, and the 10-second packet-loss window.

changes.change: Normalize the native receiver stats timestamp with the existing webRtcStatsTimestampMs helper before building receiver snapshots.
Add a widget regression using native microsecond timestamps; it expects 60 decoded FPS and 4000 kbit/s from a two-second sample delta. The test failed before the conversion and passes after it.
